issue: 401 after leaving a browser tab idle
symptoms: TOKEN_EXPIRED after 15 minutes; the next protected request fails
root_cause: The access token expired while the session remained open.
resolution: For TOKEN_EXPIRED, obtain a new access token using POST /auth/refresh and retry the original request once.
Refresh tokens are single-use and rotate on every refresh.
Serialize refresh attempts per browser session.
If refresh returns 401, sign in again instead of retrying forever.

issue: Reader cannot close a ticket
symptoms: Ticket reads work but close returns 403 SCOPE_MISSING
root_cause: The reader role lacks the operator close scope.
resolution: Check the required scope and the account role when closing a ticket returns 403.
Ask a workspace administrator to grant the operator role when appropriate.
Acquire a fresh access token after a role change; old tokens retain old scope claims until expiry.
Do not disable authorization checks.

issue: 403 persists after an operator role change

root_cause: The old access token still contains the previous scope claims.

issue: 429 during a scheduled batch
symptoms: Retry-After appears during a burst of requests
root_cause: The workspace exhausted its shared 60 requests per minute allowance.
resolution: Wait for Retry-After before retrying a 429 response.
Add jitter and exponential backoff, capped at 30 seconds, when the header is absent.
Use at most three retries for transient failures.
Retry mutating requests only with an idempotency key.
Investigate all clients sharing the workspace.

issue: 429 despite a low-volume client
symptoms: Another client is making many requests to the same workspace
root_cause: The rate limit is shared across workspace clients.
resolution: Wait for Retry-After before retrying a 429 response.
Add jitter and exponential backoff, capped at 30 seconds, when the header is absent.
Use at most three retries for transient failures.

issue: Duplicate tickets after a network retry
symptoms: A timed-out POST was retried with a different Idempotency-Key
root_cause: A new key on each retry bypasses deduplication.
resolution: Generate one UUID key per intended ticket creation and reuse it across retries, including network timeouts.
Never generate a fresh key for every retry.
If a 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT occurs, compare the original payload; use a new key only for a genuinely different operation.
After 24 hours do not assume deduplication remains.

issue: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT for a ticket write

root_cause: The key is associated with a different original payload.
resolution: Generate one UUID key per intended ticket creation and reuse it across retries, including network timeouts.

issue: Webhook signature fails after JSON parsing
symptoms: HMAC comparison fails after reserializing the event body
root_cause: JSON reserialization changed the signed raw bytes.
resolution: Read the raw body before parsing JSON and verify the signature using the endpoint's signing secret.
Reject invalid signatures.
Persist processed event_id values to ignore duplicate deliveries.
Acknowledge valid events quickly with 2xx and process them asynchronously.
Do not rely on event arrival order.

issue: Gateway 504 during a slow export
symptoms: Request exceeds ten seconds and gateway returns 504
root_cause: Synchronous upstream work exceeded the gateway deadline.
resolution: Find X-Request-ID in gateway and worker logs to identify the slow dependency.
Move work longer than 10 seconds to a queued operation and return 202 with a job ID.
For ticket writes, retry only with the original Idempotency-Key.
Avoid blindly raising timeouts or repeating writes with new keys.

issue: Ticket write times out and may have succeeded

root_cause: A socket timeout does not prove the write failed.

issue: 400 CURSOR_INVALID after changing filters
symptoms: Saved next_cursor is sent with a new ticket filter
root_cause: The opaque cursor belongs to the original filters and sort.
resolution: Pass next_cursor unchanged to fetch the next page with the same filters and sort.
Restart pagination if filters change or a cursor returns 400 CURSOR_INVALID.
Stop when next_cursor is absent.
Do not construct or decode cursor values, and do not combine a cursor with different filters.

issue: Ticket listing repeats the first page

issue: 413 for a large attachment
symptoms: An 11 MiB PDF upload is rejected
root_cause: The attachment exceeds the 10 MiB size limit.
resolution: Check file size before uploading when the server returns 413.
Compress or split large attachments below 10 MiB.
For 415 verify the file type and multipart Content-Type.
Let the HTTP library generate the multipart boundary instead of setting a bare multipart/form-data header.
Executable attachments are not supported.

symptoms: A new RELAYDESK_API_URL is set in a shell
root_cause: The running process captured its environment at startup.
resolution: Set both required environment variables and restart the process after a configuration change.

issue: DNS failure before any HTTP response
symptoms: Configured RelayDesk hostname cannot be resolved
root_cause: DNS resolver connectivity or the configured hostname is incorrect.
resolution: For DNS failures, verify the configured hostname and resolver connectivity.
For certificate errors, verify the hostname, system clock and trusted CA bundle.

issue: Export job remains queued while API is healthy
symptoms: 202 returned but job never reaches running
root_cause: No healthy worker is subscribed to that workspace queue.
resolution: When exports remain queued, check worker heartbeats and workspace queue subscriptions.
Start or restart the missing worker and inspect worker logs for startup errors.
Poll GET /jobs/{job_id} with backoff until succeeded or failed.
Use the returned failure reason; do not poll without a time limit.

issue: 412 while editing a ticket in two sessions
symptoms: A second PATCH uses an old If-Match ETag
root_cause: Another update changed the ticket version.
resolution: On a 412, fetch the latest ticket and ETag, compare changes, and merge intentionally before retrying PATCH with the new If-Match value.
Do not reuse a stale ETag or remove the precondition header.
If changes conflict, ask the operator to resolve the conflict rather than silently overwrite data.
